entry.name: mc.stepfun~
entry.digest: Generate a Function Sequenced by Input Phasors (multichannel)
entry.description: The stepfun~ object generates a breakpoint function whose timing is determined by a seqeuence of input phasor ramps. If the input ramps are non-linear, the output of stepfun~ will be similarly non-linear.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: resets the sequence step to the beginning

messages.name: float
messages.description: received in the left inlet sets the sequence to a single constant value; if ais followed by a list, it will be interpreted as the initial value of the sequence reflecting the convention of the breakpoint function format sent by theobject.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Define sequence or set step number
messages.description: In left inlet: converted toIn right inlet: sets the current step number; this message has no effect if a signal is connected to the right inlet.

messages.name: list
messages.description: sets the sequence of output values; if the list has curve data and theattribute is set to parse curve values, the curve parameter will also be set for the corresponding step. The curve parameter varies between -1 and 1, a value of 0 means no curve. For more information see theobject.

messages.name: signal
messages.digest: In left inlet: Phasor sequence inputIn right inlet: Step number

messages.name: step
messages.description: The messagefollowed by a number sets the current step. Steps are numbered starting at 0. If a signal is connected to the right inlet, themessage has no effect.

inlets.description: If an input signal is connected to the right inlet of, it determines the step number to use for the function output. Typically you would connect the right outlet ofto the right inlet ofto keep the two objects in sync. If no signal inlet is connected the right inlet can be used to change the step number, and the functon output advances to the next step and/or resets back to the beginning each time the input phasor resets.

outlets.description: A breakpoint function ramping between the current sequence of values (set via themessage or via theattribute).
A constant signal that reflects the current step number in the sequence of values.
